transcript.en: Hello everyone and welcome back to EnglishPod. My name is Marco.
transcript.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到 EnglishPod。我是马可。

transcript.en: I'm Erika.
transcript.zh: 我是艾瑞卡。

transcript.en: And today we have a great intermediate lesson for you.
transcript.zh: 今天我们为大家准备了一节很棒的中级课程。

transcript.en: That's right. We've got some excellent real English for you all about cleaning the house.
transcript.zh: 没错，我们为你们准备了一些关于打扫房子的优秀地道英语。

transcript.en: Cleaning the house. That's a real-life situation, so we're going to give you real English.
transcript.zh: 打扫房子——这是一个真实的生活场景，所以我们要教你们地道英语。

transcript.en: Exactly. So in today's lesson, we're going to look at language about cleaning the house.
transcript.zh: 没错。在今天的课程中，我们要学习关于打扫房子的语言。

transcript.en: We're also going to learn a few phrases that you can use if you want to ask someone for help and maybe if you're a little bit lazy like me, a phrase or two to avoid doing work.
transcript.zh: 我们还会学几个短语，如果你想请别人帮忙可以用到；如果你像我一样有点懒的话，还会学到一两个偷懒的短语。

transcript.en: Okay, well let's get started then with our vocabulary preview.
transcript.zh: 好了，那我们从词汇预览开始吧。

transcript.en: Vocabulary preview.
transcript.zh: 词汇预览。

transcript.en: All right, great. We have two great words for you today. Erika, why don't you tell us the first one?
transcript.zh: 好的，很好。今天我们有两个很棒的词。艾瑞卡，你来告诉我们第一个吧？

transcript.en: The first word is such a mess.
transcript.zh: 第一个词是 such a mess（太乱了/一团糟）。

transcript.en: Such a mess.
transcript.zh: Such a mess.

transcript.en: Such a mess.
transcript.zh: Such a mess.

transcript.en: So when something is a mess.
transcript.zh: 当某物是 a mess 的时候……

transcript.en: It's dirty.
transcript.zh: 它是脏的。

transcript.en: Yeah, or things are everywhere.
transcript.zh: 对，或者东西到处都是。

transcript.en: Disorganized.
transcript.zh: 杂乱无章。

transcript.en: Yeah, so you have your clothes on the floor and your shoes on...
transcript.zh: 是的，比如你把衣服扔在地上，鞋子放在……

transcript.en: Okay, so that sounds a lot like my desk at work.
transcript.zh: 好的，这听起来很像我在公司的办公桌。

transcript.en: Your shoes on your desk. Yeah, I've seen that. I've been wanting to ask you about that.
transcript.zh: 你的鞋子放在桌子上。是的，我看到过。我一直想问问你这件事。

transcript.en: Okay, such a mess. Really, really dirty.
transcript.zh: 好的，such a mess——就是非常非常脏。

transcript.en: Okay, now let's take a look at our second word, chores.
transcript.zh: 好的，现在来看第二个词——chores（家务活）。

transcript.en: Chores.
transcript.zh: Chores.

transcript.en: Chores.
transcript.zh: Chores.

transcript.en: Chores.
transcript.zh: Chores.

transcript.en: Chores is a really common word for...
transcript.zh: Chores 是一个非常常用的词，指的是……

transcript.en: Things you have to do around the house.
transcript.zh: 你必须在家里做的事情。

transcript.en: Like for example, laundry.
transcript.zh: 比如说，洗衣服。

transcript.en: Or making the bed.
transcript.zh: 或者整理床铺。

transcript.en: Or when you have to take out the garbage.
transcript.zh: 或者你必须去倒垃圾的时候。

transcript.en: Those are all examples of chores.
transcript.zh: 这些都是家务活的例子。

transcript.en: Chores, yeah. I guess everyone can remember when they were kids, they had chores to do.
transcript.zh: 家务活——是的。我想每个人都记得小时候要做家务。

transcript.en: Yeah, when I was a kid, it was my chore to chop wood.
transcript.zh: 是的，我小时候的家务活是砍柴。

transcript.en: Chop wood?
transcript.zh: 砍柴？

transcript.en: Yeah.
transcript.zh: 是啊。

transcript.en: That's a great chore. Playing with an axe.
transcript.zh: 那是个很棒的家务活——玩斧头。

transcript.en: Maybe if you're a boy, but for a girl, it was not so great.
transcript.zh: 对男孩子来说可能不错，但对女孩子来说就不那么好了。

transcript.en: That's why you're so strong and fit.
transcript.zh: 难怪你这么强壮健康。

transcript.en: Alright, so let's listen to our dialogue for the first time. It's going to be kind of fast.
transcript.zh: 好了，让我们来听第一遍对话。语速会有点快。

transcript.en: But don't worry if you miss something, because we'll explain all of the important language afterwards.
transcript.zh: 但如果你漏掉了什么也不用担心，因为我们会在之后解释所有重要的语言点。

transcript.en: Honey, the house is such a mess. I need you to help me tidy up a bit. My boss and her husband are coming over for dinner and the house needs to be spotless.
transcript.zh: 亲爱的，家里太乱了！我需要你帮我收拾一下。我老板和她丈夫今晚要来吃饭，房子必须一尘不染！

transcript.en: I'm in the middle of something right now. I'll be there in a second.
transcript.zh: 我现在正忙着呢。我一会儿就好。

transcript.en: This can't wait. I need your help now.
transcript.zh: 这不能等！我现在就需要你帮忙！

transcript.en: Alright, alright. I'm coming.
transcript.zh: 好吧，好吧。我来了。

transcript.en: Okay, here's a list of chores we need to get done. I'll do the dishes and get all the groceries for tonight. You can sweep and mop the floors. Oh, and the furniture needs to be dusted.
transcript.zh: 好的，这是我们得干的家务清单。我来洗碗和买今晚要用的杂货。你来扫地拖地。哦，还有家具上的灰也得擦。

transcript.en: You know what? I have to pick something up in the mall. So why don't you clean the floors and I'll go to the supermarket and get all the groceries.
transcript.zh: 这样吧，我得去商场买点东西，要不你来打扫地板，我去超市买菜。

transcript.en: Sure, that's fine. Here's the list of all the things you need to get. Don't forget anything.
transcript.zh: 可以，没问题。这是你要买的所有东西的清单。别忘了任何一样！

transcript.en: And can you pick up a bottle of wine on your way home?
transcript.zh: 还有，回家路上能带一瓶红酒回来吗？

transcript.en: Hey honey, I'm back.
transcript.zh: 嘿，亲爱的，我回来了。

transcript.en: Wow, the house looks really good.
transcript.zh: 哇，房子看起来真不错！

transcript.en: Great. Can you set the table?
transcript.zh: 太好了！你能摆一下桌子吗？

transcript.en: Just a sec. I'm just going to vacuum this rug real fast.
transcript.zh: 等一下，我先把这个地毯快速吸一下。

transcript.en: Wait, don't turn it on.
transcript.zh: 等等！别开那个……

transcript.en: Oh my god, Marco, what happened there?
transcript.zh: 天哪，马可，发生了什么？

transcript.en: An explosion.
transcript.zh: 爆炸了。

transcript.en: We love a good explosion here at English Flash.
transcript.zh: 我们在 EnglishPod 最喜欢一场精彩的爆炸了。

transcript.en: We're going to give you as many explosions as possible.
transcript.zh: 我们会尽量给大家多来点爆炸场面。

transcript.en: Okay.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: So let's take a look at our language takeaway.
transcript.zh: 让我们来看看语言要点。

transcript.en: Language takeaway.
transcript.zh: 语言要点。

transcript.en: So language takeaway is the part of our lesson where we teach you what we think are some really important words that are found in the dialogue.
transcript.zh: 语言要点是我们课程中教大家对话里出现的一些非常重要词汇的部分。

transcript.en: Exactly. And we have three really important words in our dialogue today. So let's start with the first one.
transcript.zh: 没错。今天我们对话中有三个非常重要的词。让我们从第一个开始。

transcript.en: Tidy up.
transcript.zh: Tidy up（整理/收拾）。

transcript.en: Tidy up.
transcript.zh: Tidy up.

transcript.en: Tidy up.
transcript.zh: Tidy up.

transcript.en: So to tidy up means to...
transcript.zh: 所以 tidy up 的意思是……

transcript.en: Put things in their correct spot.
transcript.zh: 把东西放到它们该在的位置。

transcript.en: Right. So put the shoes on the floor.
transcript.zh: 对。所以把鞋子放到地板上。

transcript.en: Get those shoes off my desk.
transcript.zh: 把那些鞋子从我桌上拿开。

transcript.en: Exactly. So tidy up, organize things a little bit.
transcript.zh: 没错。所以 tidy up 就是整理一下，把东西稍微归整一下。

transcript.en: Yeah. Put things away.
transcript.zh: 是的，把东西收起来。

transcript.en: Okay. Let's take a look at our second word now. Spotless.
transcript.zh: 好的，现在来看第二个词。Spotless（一尘不染）。

transcript.en: Spotless.
transcript.zh: Spotless.

transcript.en: Spotless.
transcript.zh: Spotless.

transcript.en: Spotless.
transcript.zh: Spotless.

transcript.en: So when you want something to be spotless...
transcript.zh: 所以当你希望某物 spotless 的时候……

transcript.en: You want it to be really clean.
transcript.zh: 你希望它非常干净。

transcript.en: Really clean, not a spot of dirt on it.
transcript.zh: 非常干净，上面没有一点污渍。

transcript.en: Like your desk.
transcript.zh: 就像你的桌子。

transcript.en: Exactly. My desk is spotless.
transcript.zh: 没错，我的桌子一尘不染。

transcript.en: My desk is not spotless.
transcript.zh: 我的桌子可不是一尘不染。

transcript.en: All right. Great word. Now let's take a look at our last word for language takeaway. Mall.
transcript.zh: 好的，很棒的词。现在看语言要点的最后一个词。Mall（商场）。

transcript.en: Mall.
transcript.zh: Mall.

transcript.en: Mall.
transcript.zh: Mall.

transcript.en: M-A-L-L, mall.
transcript.zh: M-A-L-L，mall。

transcript.en: Mall. Yeah. It's a strange sounding word.
transcript.zh: Mall——是的，这个词听起来有点奇怪。

transcript.en: It is a little bit funny sounding, but it basically means a large building with many shops inside, many different stores inside.
transcript.zh: 确实有点好笑，但它基本意思是一栋大型建筑，里面有很多商店。

transcript.en: Right. Now in British English, you would say shopping center.
transcript.zh: 对。在英式英语中，你会说 shopping center（购物中心）。

transcript.en: Yeah. I think that's a little bit more common, but in American English, we say mall.
transcript.zh: 是的，我觉得那更常用一些，但在美式英语中我们说 mall。

transcript.en: Mall. Great. So now it's time in our show to look at putting it together.
transcript.zh: Mall——很好。那么现在到了我们节目的融会贯通环节。

transcript.en: Putting it together.
transcript.zh: 融会贯通。

transcript.en: Okay. So in putting it together, we take a word from the dialogue and we show you how to use this word in real English. So we give you a couple of examples of how this particular
transcript.zh: 好的。在融会贯通中，我们从对话中拿出一个词，然后教大家如何在地道英语中使用这个词。我们给大家几个例子来看这个特定的词

transcript.en: word can be used.
transcript.zh: 可以如何使用。

transcript.en: Exactly. So the word that we have for today is groceries.
transcript.zh: 没错。今天我们选的词是 groceries（杂货/食品杂货）。

transcript.en: Groceries.
transcript.zh: Groceries.

transcript.en: Groceries.
transcript.zh: Groceries.

transcript.en: Groceries.
transcript.zh: Groceries.

transcript.en: Erica, why don't you tell us what groceries are all about?
transcript.zh: 艾瑞卡，你来告诉大家 groceries 是什么意思？

transcript.en: So groceries are all of the food items that you need to buy at the supermarket. So like your bread and milk and meat and...
transcript.zh: Groceries 就是所有你需要在超市买的食品。比如你的面包、牛奶、肉和……

transcript.en: Vegetables.
transcript.zh: 蔬菜。

transcript.en: Exactly. Those are all groceries.
transcript.zh: 没错，这些都是 groceries。

transcript.en: Okay. So let's listen to some examples on how we use this phrase.
transcript.zh: 好的，让我们来听一些例子，看看这个短语怎么用。

transcript.en: Example one.
transcript.zh: 例一。

transcript.en: There's no milk. Can you go to the grocery store?
transcript.zh: 没牛奶了。你能去一趟杂货店吗？

transcript.en: Example two.
transcript.zh: 例二。

transcript.en: Here's the grocery list. I need all of these things so that I can cook dinner tonight.
transcript.zh: 这是购物清单。我需要所有这些来做今晚的晚饭。

transcript.en: Don't forget anything.
transcript.zh: 别忘了任何一样。

transcript.en: Example three.
transcript.zh: 例三。

transcript.en: I hate grocery shopping. I can never find what I'm looking for.
transcript.zh: 我讨厌逛超市。我永远找不到我要找的东西。

transcript.en: Okay. Great examples. We heard some really interesting combinations, right?
transcript.zh: 好的，很好的例子。我们听到了一些非常有趣的搭配，对吧？

transcript.en: Yeah. We heard grocery store.
transcript.zh: 是的，我们听到了 grocery store（杂货店）。

transcript.en: Which is where you buy your groceries.
transcript.zh: 就是你去买杂货的地方。

transcript.en: Exactly. Grocery shopping.
transcript.zh: 没错。Grocery shopping（逛超市/买菜）。

transcript.en: Buying all your groceries.
transcript.zh: 买你所有的食品杂货。

transcript.en: And grocery list.
transcript.zh: 还有 grocery list（购物清单）。

transcript.en: Where you have all the items that you need to buy.
transcript.zh: 上面列出了所有你需要买的东西。

transcript.en: A list of everything you need to buy.
transcript.zh: 一张列出所有你需要购买物品的清单。

transcript.en: Exactly.
transcript.zh: 没错。

transcript.en: You know, grocery store. I think this is quite a common word in Canada.
transcript.zh: 你知道吗，grocery store——我觉得这个词在加拿大非常常用。

transcript.en: Probably North America.
transcript.zh: 可能整个北美都是。

transcript.en: Yeah. Do you say grocery store in America?
transcript.zh: 是的。在美国你们说 grocery store 吗？

transcript.en: Well, if it's a small one.
transcript.zh: 嗯，如果是小的那种。

transcript.en: Really?
transcript.zh: 真的吗？

transcript.en: Like a small store.
transcript.zh: 比如小型商店。

transcript.en: In Canada, I say grocery store for even like a supermarket.
transcript.zh: 在加拿大，就算是超市我也说 grocery store。

transcript.en: Really?
transcript.zh: 真的吗？

transcript.en: Yeah.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: I would say supermarket for a large one and grocery store for a little corner shop.
transcript.zh: 我会说大的是 supermarket，小的街角店是 grocery store。

transcript.en: All of these little differences in American Canadian English.
transcript.zh: 这些美式英语和加拿大英语之间的小差异。

transcript.en: Okay. I think it's time for us to listen to our dialogue another time. This time it'll be a little bit slower.
transcript.zh: 好的，我想是时候再听一遍对话了。这次会慢一点。

transcript.en: Honey, the house is such a mess. I need you to help me tidy up a bit. My boss and her husband are coming over for dinner and the house needs to be spotless.
transcript.zh: 亲爱的，家里太乱了！我需要你帮我收拾一下。我老板和她丈夫今晚要来吃饭，房子必须一尘不染！

transcript.en: I'm in the middle of something right now. I'll be there in a second.
transcript.zh: 我现在正忙着呢。我一会儿就好。

transcript.en: This can't wait. I need your help now.
transcript.zh: 这不能等！我现在就需要你帮忙！

transcript.en: All right. All right. I'm coming.
transcript.zh: 好吧，好吧。我来了。

transcript.en: Okay. Here's a list of chores we need to get done. I'll do the dishes and get all the groceries for tonight. You can sweep and mop the floors. Oh, and the furniture needs to be dusted.
transcript.zh: 好的，这是我们得干的家务清单。我来洗碗和买今晚要用的杂货。你来扫地拖地。哦，还有家具上的灰也得擦。

transcript.en: You know what? I have to pick something up at the mall. So why don't you clean the floors and I'll go to the supermarket and get all the groceries.
transcript.zh: 这样吧，我得去商场买点东西，要不你来打扫地板，我去超市买菜。

transcript.en: Sure. That's fine. Here's the list of all the things you need to get. Don't forget anything.
transcript.zh: 可以，没问题。这是你要买的所有东西的清单。别忘了任何一样！

transcript.en: And can you pick up a bottle of wine on your way home?
transcript.zh: 还有，回家路上能带一瓶红酒回来吗？

transcript.en: Hey, honey, I'm back. Wow. The house looks really good.
transcript.zh: 嘿，亲爱的，我回来了。哇，房子看起来真不错！

transcript.en: Great. Can you set the table?
transcript.zh: 太好了！你能摆一下桌子吗？

transcript.en: Just a sec. I'm just gonna vacuum this rug real fast.
transcript.zh: 等一下，我先把这个地毯快速吸一下。

transcript.en: Wait, don't turn it on.
transcript.zh: 等等！别开那个……

transcript.en: Okay. Great stuff. Love hearing that explosion. That vacuum just is a bomb.
transcript.zh: 好的，太精彩了。喜欢听那声爆炸。那吸尘器就是颗炸弹。

transcript.en: Yeah. In this dialogue, there was some really interesting language that you can use if you don't want to do any chores in the house.
transcript.zh: 是的。在这段对话中，有一些非常有趣的语言，如果你不想做家务可以用到。

transcript.en: Exactly. So it's time now for Fluency Builder.
transcript.zh: 没错。那么现在是流利表达时间。

transcript.en: Fluency Builder.
transcript.zh: 流利表达。

transcript.en: You know, Fluency Builder is a part of our show that we use to take a common phrase or a word that you already know and show you how to express that idea more fluently and
transcript.zh: 流利表达是我们节目的一部分，我们选取一个你已经知道的常用短语或单词，然后教你如何更流利、

transcript.en: more naturally.
transcript.zh: 更自然地表达那个意思。

transcript.en: Exactly. So let's take a look at our first idea that we want to explain.
transcript.zh: 没错。那么让我们来看第一个想解释的点。

transcript.en: Let's say you're watching TV like the woman in this dialogue and your husband wants you to help him do the chores and you say, no, I'm busy.
transcript.zh: 假设你像对话中的那位女士一样在看电视，而你的丈夫想要你帮他做家务，你说：「不，我忙着呢。」

transcript.en: Right. Or I'm doing something.
transcript.zh: 对。或者说「我在做某事。」

transcript.en: Those are two great expressions, but we heard something a little bit different in the dialogue.
transcript.zh: 这是两个很好的表达，但我们在对话中听到了一些稍微不同的说法。

transcript.en: I'm in the middle of something right now.
transcript.zh: I'm in the middle of something right now（我现在正忙着呢）。

transcript.en: I'm in the middle of something right now.
transcript.zh: I'm in the middle of something right now.

transcript.en: Yeah, that phrase is great. It means she's busy. She's doing something.
transcript.zh: 是的，这个短语很棒。意思是她很忙，她正在做某事。

transcript.en: Yeah. I'm in the middle of something.
transcript.zh: 是的。I'm in the middle of something.

transcript.en: Yeah.
transcript.zh: 对。

transcript.en: And so, Marco, you can tell us about our next phrase.
transcript.zh: 那么，马可，你来告诉我们下一个短语。

transcript.en: Okay. Well, now suppose that you want to say, you'll be there soon.
transcript.zh: 好的。嗯，现在假设你想说你很快就到。

transcript.en: You might say, I'll be there soon or...
transcript.zh: 你可能会说 I'll be there soon 或者……

transcript.en: I'm coming.
transcript.zh: I'm coming（我来了）。

transcript.en: Exactly.
transcript.zh: 没错。

transcript.en: But in our dialogue, we heard something a little bit different. Let's listen.
transcript.zh: 但在我们的对话中，我们听到了一些稍微不同的说法。让我们来听。

transcript.en: I'll be there in a second.
transcript.zh: I'll be there in a second（我马上就到）。

transcript.en: I'll be there in a second.
transcript.zh: I'll be there in a second.

transcript.en: So this is a more natural way of saying, I'll be there very soon.
transcript.zh: 所以这是一种更自然的方式说我很快就到。

transcript.en: Yeah. You know what? I think I use this phrase almost every day. I'll be there in a second.
transcript.zh: 是啊。你知道吗？我想我几乎每天都在用这个短语——I'll be there in a second。

transcript.en: Yeah. Yeah. It's really common.
transcript.zh: 是的，真的很常见。

transcript.en: Yeah. It means I'll be there really fast.
transcript.zh: 是的，意思是我很快就来。

transcript.en: Yes.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: Okay. So our final item today in Fluency Builder is a great phrase that helps you say the idea of, could you or would you?
transcript.zh: 好的。那么今天流利表达的最后一个项目是一个很棒的短语，帮助你表达「could you」或「would you」的意思。

transcript.en: Right. Or can you?
transcript.zh: 对。或者 can you？

transcript.en: Yeah. So, can you sweep the floor? Could you sweep the floor?
transcript.zh: 是的。所以，can you sweep the floor？Could you sweep the floor？

transcript.en: But in the dialogue, we heard something that's a little bit different.
transcript.zh: 但在对话中，我们听到了一些稍微不同的说法。

transcript.en: Why don't you clean the floors and I'll go to the supermarket?
transcript.zh: Why don't you clean the floors and I'll go to the supermarket？（要不你来打扫地板，我去超市？）

transcript.en: Why don't you clean the floors and I'll go to the supermarket?
transcript.zh: Why don't you clean the floors and I'll go to the supermarket？

transcript.en: Great. So this is more natural and it's giving a suggestion.
transcript.zh: 很好。所以这更自然，而且是在给出一个建议。

transcript.en: Yeah. It's sort of a polite way of asking someone to clean the floors.
transcript.zh: 是的。这是一种礼貌地请某人打扫地板的方式。

transcript.en: Right. It's a really good and polite way of saying it. Yeah. I would agree on that.
transcript.zh: 对。这是一种非常好且礼貌的表达方式。是的，我同意。

transcript.en: This was Fluency Builder. Now we are ready to listen to our dialogue again at its normal speed.
transcript.zh: 这就是流利表达。现在我们准备再听一遍对话，正常语速。
